title: Stable Influence of an Averaged Neighbor Function
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game of dimension $q$, let a long-code table be given, and let $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$. For every vertex $v$ and coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,q\}$, the stable influence at parameter $1-\varepsilon$ of the averaged neighbor function at $v$ is at most the uniform expectation over neighbors $w$ of the stable influence, at the same parameter, of the table function at $w$ in the coordinate corresponding to $i$ under the inverse permutation on the edge from $v$ to $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ of dimension $q$
A long-code table on the vertices of $G$
